look: Static Sprite, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Static Sprites family: tiny crackling spark sprite with a mischievous face. Family anatomy: crackling spark sprites and storm spirits stitched with lightning. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are electric-yellow static crystal. Element Lightning: electric yellow, cyan and indigo accents, tiny subtle branching arcs, static sparks and crackling halos
